upper_bound: Choose any vertex of K6. Among its five incident edges at least three share a color. If any edge joining their other endpoints has that color there is a monochromatic triangle through the chosen vertex; otherwise the three endpoints form a triangle in the other color.
lower_bound: On vertices 0,1,2,3,4 modulo 5, color the five cycle edges red and every remaining edge blue. The red graph is the cycle 0-1-2-3-4-0 and the blue graph is the cycle 0-2-4-1-3-0, so neither color contains a triangle.
dependency_policy: The accepted fact is self-contained and uses no predecessor facts or external results.
